title: Small Town, Big Promise
paragraphs: Micah was a country prophet who spoke up for ordinary people. He did not name a great city. He named a tiny one: "But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth" (KJV). Bethlehem was a village. Nobody important lived there. Yet God said a ruler, one whose roots go back to long ago, would come out of it, and he would feed his flock and bring peace. So when we reach the stable, remember: this was foretold. Small places matter to God, and small people too.
wonder: I wonder what it means that God's big plans often start in small places?
activity: Make a "map of small things" showing places in your village you love.
prayer: God of small places, bless our village and town, and show us how much they matter to you. Amen.
alt: A tiny hill village under a huge sky with a golden thread reaching down to one small rooftop.
hidden: A tiny sheep on the highest roof.
translation: Retold in our own words, with a short quotation from the King James Version.
